title: Disproof of the dominating Hadwiger conjecture
summary: Hadwiger's conjecture (1943) states that every graph $G$ with chromatic number at least $t$ contains a $K_t$-model: a collection of $t$ vertex-disjoint connected subgraphs $T_1,\dots,T_t$ such that for all $1\le i<j\le t$ some vertex in $T_j$ has a neighbour in $T_i$. Replacing "some" in this definition by "every" gives rise to the significantly stronger notion of a dominating $K_t$-model introduced by Illingworth and Wood (2024).
